newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva private bank says 96 profit up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Geneva private bank says 96 profit up slightly.

text.p: Geneva private bank Compagnie Bancaire Geneve CBG reported a 2.4 percent increase in gross profits in 1996 over a year ago.

CBG, which this year took over another Geneva bank, Banque D'Investissements Prives (BIP), said 1996 gross profits totalled 13.3 million Swiss francs. Revenues from commissions and services were 18.4 million francs, it said but gave no details.
The bank is owned 60 percent by two private Swiss partners and 40 percent by Banque Cantonale de Geneve.
Secretive Swiss banks do not reveal detailed data on their fee-paying, advice-based private banking business and bank annual reports provide only scant information.
